tiles.name: y_basis_high
tiles.description: Repeated 8x8 luma blocks with higher-frequency single-coefficient basis patterns.

tiles.name: cb_basis_low
tiles.description: Repeated 8x8 chroma-Cb basis patterns at constant luma.

tiles.name: cr_basis_low

tiles.description: Single-pixel luma impulses at varying offsets within each 8x8 block.

tiles.name: saturated_quads

tiles.name: smooth_ramps
